map.总工时（人·小时） = 时长/60 × 参会人数；人力成本 = 总工时 × 人均: Total work hours (person-hours) = duration/60 x attendees; labour cost = total work hours x average hourly rate; total cost = labour cost + venue/equipment fee; cost per minute = total cost / duration (minutes); cost per person = total cost / attendees
map.会议的真实成本是\"所有人时间的机会成本\"，所以按人·小时而非自然时长计价。人: The real cost of a meeting is "the opportunity cost of everyone's time", so it is priced in person-hours rather than natural duration. For the average hourly rate, divide the annual salary by actual annual working hours (about 2000) - or use a weighted average for mixed-seniority meetings - otherwise meetings with executives are undervalued. The cost per minute helps judge "what trimming 10 more minutes is worth", and the cost per person compares meetings of different sizes. The result is an estimate: it excludes hidden time such as follow-up and material preparation, and travel or venue opportunity costs.
